title: Approval
description: Record of one approval request for one exact call: what the approvers saw, who voted, and how each of them signed in. An approved request lets the STS issue a single-use grant bound to action_hash.

closed.description: When the request stopped being pending.

consent.description: The consent the grant rests on, for a user mandate.

grant.description: jti of the grant the call was made under.

user.description: The user the agent acts for, under a user mandate. On a user route this is the only voter; on a group route they never vote.

route.description: Who was asked, from the mandate.

action.description: The call in canonical form, exactly as the approvers saw it.

action_hash.description: Digest of action's canonical form (RFC 8785). The single-use grant is bound to it.

policy_version.description: The policy in force when the request was made. A change of policy voids the request.

required.description: How many distinct approvals were needed, from the mandate.

single_use_grant.description: jti of the single-use grant the STS issued once the request was approved.

allOf.description: An open request has no closing time and no grant.
Only an approved request leads to a grant.
A user route needs the user.

auth_time.description: When the approver signed in for this vote; no earlier than the mandate's max_auth_age allows.

acr.description: How strongly the approver signed in (OIDC acr).
